rows.name: MVRV Z-Score
rows.blurb: Market cap vs realized cap in standard deviations. Deep lows mark historic bottoms.

rows.name: MVRV Ratio
rows.blurb: Market value / realized value. Below ~1 means the average holder is underwater.

rows.name: Net Unrealized P/L (NUPL)
rows.blurb: Share of supply sitting in profit. Negative = net-unrealized-loss capitulation.

rows.name: SOPR
rows.blurb: Spent-output profit ratio. Sustained sub-1 means coins move at a loss.

rows.name: Reserve Risk
rows.blurb: Confidence of long-term holders vs price. Lows flag attractive risk/reward.

rows.name: Short-Term Holder MVRV
rows.blurb: Cost-basis ratio of recent buyers. Deep lows = fresh money deeply underwater.

rows.name: Long-Term Holder MVRV
rows.blurb: Cost-basis ratio of seasoned holders. Lows accompany late-stage bear bottoms.

rows.name: Realized Price
rows.blurb: Aggregate on-chain cost basis. Spot below it means the market is underwater.

rows.name: Balanced Price
rows.blurb: Realized minus transferred price. Spot near it has marked cycle bottoms.
